question: Which offices may read the satisfaction ratings that members give their representative (an individual representative, the ranking of every representative, the free text), is a rating published when only one or two members have answered, and does a member who asks to answer anonymously stay unidentifiable to the representative and to the stewards who read the figures?
decision: Representatives see only their own aggregate when at least 5 independent responses are present and reidentification checks pass; authorized officers see suppressed comparative aggregates, not automatically raw respondent text. Free text is redacted/reviewed before disclosure. An anonymous response is stored without a rater identity and must not be re-linkable through standard telemetry/session metadata; if unlinkability cannot be proven, call it confidential rather than anonymous.
originalProposedDecision: An individual representative sees their own aggregate; officers see all. Nothing published with fewer than 5 responses. Free text only to officers, stripped of names. Anonymous answers are unlinkable: store no rater id when anonymity is chosen.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
